task_completion.description: Set the observer location to Saturn in Stellarium.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The Location window or the status bar at the bottom of the Stellarium screen should show 'Saturn' as the observer location.

task_completion.description: Set the simulation time to July 19, 2013, at 21:27 UTC.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The Date and Time window or the status bar should display '2013-07-19' and a time near '21:27:00'.

task_completion.description: Disable the atmosphere and ground/landscape settings.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The sky should appear black (no atmospheric scattering) and the horizon/ground texture should be invisible. The corresponding icons in the bottom toolbar should be toggled off.

task_completion.description: Enable planet labels in the simulation.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Labels for planets or celestial bodies should be visible on the screen; the 'Planet labels' icon in the bottom toolbar should be active.

task_completion.description: Search for Earth and center the camera on it.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Earth should be centered in the view, likely indicated by a selection pointer or the 'Earth' information text appearing in the top-left corner.

task_completion.description: Save the configuration to persist on boot and take a screenshot.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Configuration' window showing 'Save settings' being clicked, and a notification or file explorer view showing a new screenshot in /home/ga/Pictures/stellarium.

task_completion.description: Write the required exhibit notes to /home/ga/Desktop/cassini_exhibit.txt.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A text editor or terminal 'cat' command showing the file content with 'The Day the Earth Smiled', 'Saturn', 'Earth', and '2013'.

integrity.description: The agent used the Stellarium GUI to configure the scene rather than just editing config files via terminal.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show the mouse cursor interacting with Stellarium menus (Location, Date/Time, Search) and toolbar icons.

integrity.description: The visual scene matches the physics of the requested date and location.
integrity.visual_evidence: The star field and planetary positions (Saturn's rings visible from a Saturn-centric view) match the 2013-07-19 timestamp.

integrity.description: The agent manually typed or generated the notes file based on the task instructions.
integrity.visual_evidence: The agent is seen opening a text editor or using a redirection command in the terminal to create the specific file path.
